{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq (descending)
data_sorted = data.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False])

# Drop duplicates on patient_id, keeping first (i.e., highest sample_seq)
data_dedup = data_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Verify number of patients
n_patients = len(data_dedup)
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_patients}')

# Step 2: Compute response rate by arm
response_rates = data_dedup.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Extract proportions
print(f'Treatment response rate: {response_rates["treatment"]}')
print(f'Control response rate: {response_rates["control"]}')

# Compute treatment effect
treatment_effect = response_rates['treatment'] - response_rates['control']
print(f'Treatment effect (treatment minus control): {treatment_effect}')"}
